_doc: Reference data for benchmarking the Castor pipeline against a vertical SaaS Point-of-Sale + back-of-house platform for independent multi-location restaurant chains.

venture_under_test.name: Sliceline
venture_under_test.description: Sliceline is a B2B vertical SaaS Point-of-Sale (POS) and back-of-house operations platform for independent restaurant chains with 5-50 locations. We bundle POS, online ordering, kitchen display systems, inventory tracking, payroll, and labor scheduling. Pricing is $99 per location per month base + 1.5% transaction fee on processed payments. Target buyer: Owner-Operator and Director of Operations at multi-unit restaurant groups. We compete with Toast, Square for Restaurants, Lightspeed Restaurant, Clover, and TouchBistro. Differentiation: built natively for multi-location franchise reporting (rolled-up P&L per region), no per-feature add-on pricing (everything in the base), and direct integration with Doordash/Uber Eats commission-fee renegotiation tools.
